reviews.text: Everyone was very friendly and took my pet’s health concerns seriously. It has been a great experience so far!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Kian.

Incredibly kind and knowledgeable team in a very welcoming clinic environment (SO beautifully decorated too). I work in the pet industry and have been to a multitude of vets over the years, and I have to say that the level of care at this clinic definitely stands out. Thank you all!
We have been seeing Dr. Chen for years and she has provided amazing care for my dog. The new space is also beautiful and very welcoming!

My dog is very nervous and scared of most things, and even though he was a little scared for his nail trim today- he was still excited to see the staff and really liked them. It was a very quick, friendly and amazing experience for us both. Definitely worth the visit and we will be back again soon. Thank you 😊
Thank you for your review, Jennifer. We appreciate it.

Very impressed with this vet clinic so far! Our newly adopted cat Denny is a new patient at Woodland, and we've been amazed by how pleasant - even relaxing - our experiences have been. And Denny is not exactly an uncomplicated patient: he came home from the shelter with explosive diarrhea, FOUR respiratory illnesses, a goopy green eye, and a broken fang. So it's not like we've just been breezing in for an annual checkup. We're navigating a somewhat stressful and mysterious medical journey with Denny, and we're very happy we're doing it at Woodland.

Our experiences with other vets haven't been terrible, just rushed and somewhat perfunctory. Visits involved minimal time with the actual vet, and I never walked out feeling particularly relieved. Stress can't always be avoided when an animal is sick, but it can be mitigated - and that takes time, which seems to be in short supply at most clinics.

Things are different at Woodland. They're upfront about being an independent practice, and the difference is genuinely noticeable. After Denny's first appointment, my wife and I basically looked at each other and were like, "Wait, was doing things THIS way always an option?"

A few things that really stood out:

- You see the vet from the outset. The first person who meets you and your animal is the vet herself. You don't have to worry about your elaborate and hysterical explanation of what's wrong being reduced to a few bullet points before the vet hears it. That takes time, but when you're worried about a sick animal, it makes a huge difference.

- Dr. Chen follows the cat's lead. She spends most of the exam literally crawling around on the floor with Denny. Instead of slamming a terrified cat onto a metal table and expecting it to remain still, she examines him wherever he feels comfortable. During our second visit, Denny decided he wanted to stay in his carrier. In the past I've had to physically upend a carrier to dump a reluctant cat out of it. Dr. Chen simply sat down, took the carrier apart, and said, "This is totally fine. I can do pretty much everything I need for this exam with him in the carrier." Eventually Denny wandered onto the couch, the exam table, and even the shelves, and by the end he was rolling around happily on the floor. I have NEVER seen an animal this relaxed at a vet appointment.

- Explanations are exceptionally clear. Dr. Chen explains complicated medical things in completely jargon-free language. She doesn't patronize us - she just understands that we're not vets. When you're worried, medical jargon quickly becomes noise. Clear explanations make it much easier to understand what's happening.

- Treatment is transparent. Pricing is very upfront, and they don't seem interested in running tests simply because they can. At Denny's first appointment, I expected the standard battery of blood and urine tests, but Dr. Chen pointed out that they weren't going to tell us anything useful beyond what we already knew. Likewise, even though Denny has symptoms of IBD, Dr. Chen and Dr. Burke have tried less invasive approaches before jumping to expensive and stressful diagnostics. We're nearing the end of a diet trial that may actually be working 🤞🤞🤞🤞🤞, which would be a huge relief. This gradual, problem-solving approach feels much more constructive than simply doing every possible test under the sun.

- The whole staff is genuinely kind and personable. Calling and having someone say, "Oh, Denny - we love that guy! How's he feeling?" makes a difference when you're dealing with a sick animal. It makes you feel like your pet is more than an anonymous list of maladies to be processed.

TL;DR: This is a fantastic veterinary practice. We feel extremely lucky that we found Woodland and have enthusiastically recommended it to our pet-owning friends. And if Denny's extensive collection of medical problems can't convince you that we've stress-tested this clinic, I don't know what can!

We’ve been seeing Dr. Chen for a few years, and every visit with her has always been exceptional. We were thrilled to see her at Woodland Vet in this beautiful clinic! Our dog was happy to see her again and meet the lovely staff.

Doctor Chen is amazing. Made my anxious guy feel right at home. Everyone there honestly is extremely helpful as well as knowledgeable. They genuinely do care for your pet’s health and you can tell they absolutely love their work.

They’ve got a separate entrance as well for reactive dogs which is 👌

I took my senior cat to Woodland Vet Clinic for his annual exam and dental surgery. Very friendly team and they are very transparent about their pricing. They have a testing bundle that includes 5+ tests at a discounted rate which I'm very grateful for as my senior cat needs more attention at his age. The team provided me a fully comprehensive quote with low and high ends for his dental (which they suggested at the annual exam). I paid exactly what I was expecting so you can be sure you won't be hit with any hidden fees. The team is very responsive over call, email and text. The doctor called me very soon after he was done his dental and explained the entire process that happened to me. Bonus too that the clinic is very aesthetic and comfy to be in. I highly recommend coming here!
Such a quality clinic. They really care about the animals and are transparent about options and costs.  My 14 year old pup hated all clinics until we found Woodland.
Wonderful veterinary clinic! Dr. Chen is so attentive and amazing with our dog. The receptionists Jenny and Sana are also so welcoming and prompt with communication.
Thank you very much for the five stars, Wesley. Much appreciated!

We had the absolute pleasure of interacting with Dr. Rebecca Burke while she was working at another vet clinic.  She was absolutely amazing - she was organized, professional, kind, compassionate and wholly caring.  She guided us through the horrific process of saying goodbye to our dearest Tiffany, a 13 year old female cat, we adopted through Vokra - well, 13 years ago!  It was a godsend to have met Dr Burke.  She is a wonderful vet but an even more amazing human being.  If you are looking for a veterinarian to take care of your dear fur baby, I would recommend Dr Burke with the highest personal referral.  She is a person who has found her calling.  I would give her 10 stars out of 5.
Dr. Rebecca Burke and the rest of the staff did an amazing job in giving Coco the most stress free examination possible. Highly recommend!

All of the staff here are so welcoming and professional! Dr. Chen is truly passionate about the well-being of all animals in her care. I feel confident knowing my cats are patients at Woodland Veterinary Clinic. The lounge and refreshments are also so lovely. My cats and I feel right at home here! We've been treated with such warmth :)

Had my first appointment today with my boy Fergus and loved the experience. All staff were super friendly and welcoming.  Dr. Chen was lovely and made my nervous boy feel comfortable. I’ll definitely be returning with my two other cats. Also the clinic itself is beautiful inside with a relaxing atmosphere:)

Dr Michelle Chen has been incredible with our 2 cats and we cannot recommend this clinic enough!

Both cats needed dental cleaning (and an extraction) and we were nervous. Our last vet hadn’t been very clear about the state of their teeth and we’d left it too long. In the end, Dr Chen brought both cats through the procedure incredibly quickly, with a phone call update midway and wonderful follow up care. The first photo is one they sent us post-procedure and the second is our cat Millie later that same day.

All procedures come with an itemized quote and pricing is transparent. They do their lab work in-house which makes it lower cost and the results super fast.

The clinic staff are some of the best people you’ll meet and we absolutely love them!

As someone who has grown up in the veterinary industry, it is so lovely to be able to take my dogs to a locally owned and incredibly caring veterinary practice. I have had appointments with both Dr. Chen and Dr. Burke, and both are kind, thoughtful and well educated/informed vets who have taken the time to explain everything to me in clear detail, all while treating my dogs in a safe, fear free space. The front desk staff and technicians are also amazing! Woodland will definitely be the only place I take my girls from now on.

Super kind and amazing care all around, from the receptionist, vet and vet technician.  I cant recommend them enough! I felt like my kitty had the best care! It's also a beautiful environment...with refreshments.  Thank you ❤️

After trying several vet clinics in the area, Woodland is by far the best!
We really appreciate their fear-free approach, especially since we’ve unfortunately experienced unnecessarily rough exams at other clinics.
Both Dr. Chen and Dr. Burke are the kindest and compassionate veterinarians we’ve ever met.
We couldn’t recommend them more highly!
Thank you for the 5 stars Courtenay, we appreciate it!

Amazing care for your fur babies. Michele Chen knows her stuff and always delivers exceptional care for our doggies. Gives me joy and confidence that our pets have the best care possible and Woodland always delivers.
This place is amazing! I only wish I had found them sooner. Jenny is amazing! Dr. Chen is kind, caring and compassionate. I don’t really trust my animals with anyone, but I trust them with her.
First visit with Dr. Michelle Chen and team: absolutely wonderful experience!

I have been bringing Dante to Woodland Vet since they opened back in March. Everyone that works here, from the front desk staff to the doctors are so incredibly thoughtful, kind, and knowledgeable.
Dr. Chen has been working with Dante, and she is very knowledgeable about his breed, his temperament, and his potential triggers. She works with him in a way that keeps him calm and is sensitive towards things that may cause him stress. I have noticed that Dante is generally much less stressed when he is here than he was at our previous vet. In fact, he is usually quite excited to go in as he knows he is about to get lots of treats.
I also really appreciate the follow-up calls that we receive after any treatment. It is very apparent that the doctors genuinely care about Dante and his wellbeing.
Can’t recommend Woodland Vet enough, I have been so happy with all the care Dante has received, and always know he’s in good hands when he’s there.

Wow! Went to Woodland vet for the first time and it was an awesome experience - lovely new clinic, very kid friendly, excellent, efficient and personable staff, and reasonably priced. Very happy to have such a great new vet clinic in the hood. We will be going there from now on. Highly recommend it!!!

I’ve had amazing experiences here. Both Dr. Burke and Dr. Chen do an incredible, thorough job and work to find a solution while keeping you fully in the loop. The surrounding staff are so kind and go out of their way to make sure my pup and I feel comfortable. This is for sure my go to vet from now on!

Highly recommend Dr. Burke and Dr. Chen!
Dr. Burke has been Benji’s vet since we brought him home as a puppy seven years ago, and we’ve followed her through several clinics — no drive was ever too far. We’re so happy she has now opened her own clinic with Dr. Chen.

They are both incredibly knowledgeable and never make anything feel like an upsell; they truly focus on our pets’ health, comfort, and overall well‑being. Communication is excellent, they’re transparent about everything, and they always take the time to answer our many, many questions. The entire team at Woodland vet is warm, caring, and wonderful.

Thank you for all the love, care, and treats you give our two boys!
The team at Woodland are so friendly and genuinely care so much about animals.  They have great availability, were knowledgeable and thorough but also reasonably priced. Could not recommend more!
Everyone at woodland is absolutely amazing. So friendly, kind and efficient! Highly recommended

I can't thank the team at Woodland Veterinary enough for the amazing care they gave Samtastic! I am only living in Vancouver for a short time with my dog and found myself in need of a vet when I noticed something a strange skin issue (I'm from the US). The team at Woodland Vet got us in and solved the problem with plenty of time before I had to go back home. It involved a surgery, which was done expertly on my aging dog. I saw both vets and both are amazing! They also communicated very well with me and with each other. Everyone cared for Sam so well. The rest of the team is equally caring and gifted ranging from the technicians to the office team. We'll miss them!

Our cat had an unexpected health crisis on a weekend, so we went to Woodland for help on Sunday, when our regular vet was closed. The whole team, especially Dr Chen, was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable & empathetic. They helped our little guy in the best way we could have hoped for.

Wow – what a wonderful clinic!

From the moment we walked in, we were treated with so much kindness and care. Our cat was examined very thoroughly, and everyone was gentle, thoughtful, and kind throughout the whole visit. Even the little details were so appreciated – complimentary sodas, flavoured water, coffee, and just a general feeling that every part of the experience had been thought through.

Dr. Burke was absolutely fantastic. She examined our cat carefully, explained everything clearly, and was very transparent about pricing, which was also competitive. Before proceeding, she confirmed the cost with us and made sure we were comfortable. She also took the time to calculate all the details of the diet our cat needs, which was incredibly helpful.

What really stood out was how much they went above and beyond. They brushed our cat, took care of a mat he had near his bottom, and did that complimentary as well. They even took photos of him for social media because they thought he was so handsome, and gave us a handwritten note with an orange cat sticker, plus a sticker and a bookmark. These are small things, but they matter so much, and they made the whole experience feel special.

You can really see them going above and beyond at every step of the care pathway. Honestly, I wish the owners of this clinic opened a primary care clinic – this is the kind of care I wish everyone could experience. It is exactly what healthcare should feel like: kind, thoughtful, transparent, thorough, and caring.

We are thrilled to have our cats treated here. I don’t think we have ever seen a clinic as wonderful as this one! 😊
My dog recently had a visit with Dr. Burke and I was so impressed with Woodland's approach to reactive dogs and fear-free methods, it was the most relaxed vet visit we've ever had.
Thank you for the 5 stars Amine - it means a lot!

I brought my staffy mix Polly to Woodland for her first vet visit in Vancouver, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

The space is beautiful, super clean, and tidy, and the staff were incredibly friendly and supportive. Polly was a bit nervous, but they made her feel at ease with their calm and gentle approach.

Dr. Burke gave her a thorough examination and was happy to answer all of my questions while explaining everything clearly. The team was so patient with Polly and went at her pace when administering her vaccines.

By the end of the visit, Polly was happy and relaxed, and I know that any future vet visits will be positive experiences for her. Thank you Woodland!

I recently moved to the neighbourhood and my neighbour highly recommended this clinic. I’m so glad she did! Dr. Chen is great vet. Kind and friendly, professional and knowledgeable. She listens carefully and provides clear explanations. I appreciate how upfront she is about the costs for everything as the options are reviewed. She is old school in the best way when helping me to decide what to do realistically for my old dog. No upselling, just helpful. The staff here are excellent too. They are very welcoming and gentle with my dog. They made her very much at ease here.
I highly recommend this clinic. It’s a great addition to our neighborhood!❤️
Thank you for the 5 stars Alex - it means a lot!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars Lina.

Care. Compassion. Expertise. Elegance. Comfort.
Welcome to our neighbourhood, Woodland Veterinary Clinic! Such a pleasure to have you here! From the very first phone contact with Jenny, to the consult with Dr. Rebecca Burke and the vet technician, my cat Gingy received the best care possible, the right annual visit and the adequate vaccinations. I received clear and precise explanations, answers to all my questions. The welcoming card was the cherry on the cake, thank you! Looking forward to many years of good pet care, we are in good hands!

I would like to express our  heartfelt gratitude to Dr. Michelle Chen. We are patients of hers at another clinic. This year, two of our three dogs became severely ill. Dr. Chen helped guide us through an incredibly difficult time with compassion, urgency, and professionalism.

She is knowledgeable, thoughtful, and she fights for her patients. From recommending treatments to sending referrals to specialists, she always made sure our dogs received the care they needed as quickly as possible. Even after we were referred to specialists, she continued to follow up with us and stayed involved in their care, which meant so much to our family.

What stood out to us was how much she genuinely cares about the animals she treats. We always felt that she was doing everything she could for our dogs and advocating for their health every step of the way. We have never had a veterinarian who cared so much.

Thanks to her care and guidance, Odin and Loki are both doing much better. We trust Dr. Chen completely and would love for her to continue being our family vet for years to come. Your pets will truly be in good hands at her clinic.

Dr. Chen was so wonderful with our two cats. Their staff were very helpful out front and the atmosphere of the clinic was calming for the cats. We would recommend if you need a new vet in your neighbourhood !

This is an absolutely beautiful vet clinic with wonderful staff! Everyone is so friendly and my dog Rosie was really comfortable and happy (all the snacks may have helped). Happy to call this our new go-to veterinary clinic :)
Bet vet I've been to and a nice calm space.

Dr. Chen is the best veterinarian I have ever met. Her care for both dogs and their owners is truly outstanding. She always shares her knowledge and takes the time to educate us on how to care for our furry babies.
The receptionist, Jenny, warmly welcomes everyone who steps into the clinic, and her follow-up and support are truly five-star quality.
I highly recommend this world-class veterinary clinic in Vancouver. We feel so lucky to have met Dr. Chen and her amazing team.
Thank you once again for treating our dog so well. We will see you again soon!

* Thank you so much for the welcome card — it truly means a lot to us ❤️
Amazing vet, highly recommend
first vet my dachshund has felt comfortable in, she is not constantly pulling me towards the door! i can tell the staff put a lot of care into the space and how they treat their clients ❣️
Thank you very much for the 5 stars Pam - we really appreciate it.

I cannot rave enough about this clinic. The vets, vet techs, vet assistants, and front desk host are so friendly and warm, it really puts you at ease the moment you walk into the beautiful space. We've been seeing Dr. Burke for 8 years now, so of course we followed her to this new clinic. The space is calming and our fur babies were very obviously at the forefront of their mind when this clinic was designed. Also, the free coffee and refreshments was such a luxurious touch, I haven't seen that at any other clinic before!
It’s a beautiful space with caring vets.

So thrilled Dr Michelle Chen has opened Woodland Veterinary Clinic in East Vancouver.  She was our previous vet closer to our home, but I will and have absolutely travelled to obtain her excellent care for my new Aussie Labradoodle puppy.

Dr Chen was amazing in supporting me through the difficult several year journey when my previous labradoodle was diagnosed with cancer.  She was an advocate and a true impartial guide for me to make the right science based decisions for the welfare of my dog in the latter stages when under specialist care.  She is kind, empathetic and my current puppy and last dog love her.

She gets down on the floor to the animal’s level and reduces their fear.   The new clinic is stunning and feels more like a spa.   So clean and comfortable cushy seating. Dr Chen is clear about pricing and they submit directly to Trupanion.    I would not hesitate to recommend the services of Woodland Veterinary Clinic.   Dr Chen is a breath of fresh air.

I couldn’t be happier with the care my dog (Muffins) received at this clinic. From the moment we walked in, the place stood out—the building is absolutely beautiful, with a clean, modern design that immediately makes you feel comfortable and confident in the level of care they provide.

Dr. Burke and Dr. Chen were both outstanding. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of my questions without rushing, and treated my doggo with such kindness and patience. It’s rare to find veterinarians who combine expertise with that level of compassion.

Easily a 5-star experience.
I brought my very excitable bulldog, Brutus to the clinic and we had a really great experience. Knowledgeable, patient staff and a beautiful clinic! Thank you!
Thank you for your review, Alysia!
Dr Chen is amazing, she takes care of our dog at our old clinic and we will take him to his next appointment here!

I cannot recommend Rebecca and Michelle at Woodland Veterinary Clinic highly enough! They have been absolutely incredible with my dog, Scooby, a mini Schnauzer!

What sets them apart is the genuine care and compassion they show during every visit.

They don’t just treat Scooby as another patient; they truly care about his health and well-being.

They take the time to explain everything in great detail, from specific health concerns to treatment options, ensuring I fully understand what's going on. It is such a relief to have professionals who are so thorough and clearly dedicated to providing the best care possible.

If you are looking for a team that is knowledgeable, patient, and truly loves animals, Rebecca and Michelle are the best!

Woodland staff are absolutely amazing. Dr. Burke and Dr. Chen are extremely attentive and thorough in their explanations and care. So happy to have them as our vets - we have a sense of comfort knowing with them our babies are extremely well taken care of. They deserve 10 stars.
Lovely experience with our pup, Noodle! Most thorough and gentle exam for our anxious guy.

I had such a great experience with Woodland Veterinary Clinic. From the moment I walked in, the team was warm, welcoming, and genuinely cared about my pet. You can really tell they take the time to listen and explain everything clearly, which gave me a lot of confidence and peace of mind.

The vets were extremely knowledgeable and patient, and they didn’t rush the appointment at all. They made sure all my questions were answered and treated my pet with so much care and attention.

The clinic itself is clean, organized, and very well run. Overall, it was a smooth and stress free experience from start to finish.

Highly recommend Woodland Veterinary Clinic to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring place for their pets.

I can't recommend Woodland Veterinary Clinic enough. From the moment we walked in, my pup and I were treated like family. Dr. Michelle Chen is wonderful. She comes across as having a real passion for animals. She took her time with a thorough exam, explained everything clearly and kindly, and gave me good options without ever making me feel pressured or like I was being sold something. I left feeling totally confident and at ease knowing my dog was in such great hands.
The clinic feels warm and calming, and it's obvious they designed it with pets and their people in mind. The whole team was friendly and professional, and the prices were reasonable.
This was one of the best vet visits we've ever had. We've already decided Woodland Veterinary Clinic is our new regular vet. Thank you to Dr. Chen and the whole team. You've earned a client for life!

So grateful to have such a friendly, inviting and wonderful veterinary practice open in this neighbourhood! Much needed for this fast growing area.

We moved to this vet due to the convenience of it being right in front of our building. But we were pleasantly surprised with the level of care and hospitality they have shown us and our two miniature dachshunds. Dr.Rebecca was so informative, thorough, and kind - our vet visits were very affirming and easy for the pups. One of our doxies is apprehensive of vet visits and they took the time to see him and get him comfortable around them. Couldn’t ask for a better team to look over our dog’s health. The vet techs and clinic hosts were all so so friendly and accommodating. You can tell from their energy that they truly care!
Also, the pricing is very fair and upfront.

Apart from your dog’s regular health check ups, vaccinations, and preventatives, they also offer anal gland expressions and nail trimmings.

Shout out to Jenny, Lilith, and Chelle for their outstanding hospitality!

Dr. Chen and the staff are amazing! We met Dr. Chen at our old clinic and she was so good with Hansel! Hansel was a rescued dog and he’s extra skittish at the vet, but Dr. Chen was so patient and accommodating with Hansel. So glad she opened her own clinic! Hansel just had his first visit and it was great!

Dr. Chen and the whole team are amazing! We knew from the moment Dr. Chen first treated Davey at our old clinic that we would be following her to Woodland, and we are so happy we did! Davey used to be so nervous at the vet, but at Woodland he was relaxed and comfortable. The team is very friendly and gentle, and they truly care. We trust Dr. Chen and the team implicitly and are so happy that Woodland is open!

We just had our first appointment. We were so excited to have a clinic opening within walking distance of home. The staff is so friendly, and the vets spend so much time with you.

With them still settling in, we had an early morning appointment and sparky escaped the exam room - but no worries, they let him explore and settle in to the space.

Sparky got very familiar with the vet very quickly understand that he’s a very affectionate rescue heeler.

We are so happy to be here!

The switch was seemless — wthey reached out to allo the places sparky had received treatment and gathered all his records.
If your looking for a warm and trustworthy vet look no further than Woodland Veterinary Clinic!

We had a wonderful first visit with Dr. Rebecca and the Woodland Vet team today!  Our cat, Gary, was curious to explore and happy to eat treats in the pristine exam room. It’s clear that the team has been thoughtful with design of the physical space and, most importantly, thoughtful in how they deliver the customer experience. Everyone was welcoming, prepared and knowledgeable. We’re so glad to have the Woodland Vet team as part of our cat’s care team!
